entries.title: Isaiah 48:1
segments: ¶"Hear this, O house of Jacob, Who are called by the name of Israel, And have come forth from the wellsprings of Judah; Who swear by the name of the LORD, And make mention of the God of Israel, [But] not in truth or in righteousness;

entries.title: Isaiah 48:2
segments: For they call themselves after the holy city, And lean on the God of Israel; The LORD of hosts [is] His name:

entries.title: Isaiah 48:3
segments: "I have declared the former things from the beginning; They went forth from My mouth, and I caused them to hear it. Suddenly I did [them], and they came to pass.

entries.title: Isaiah 48:4
segments: Because I knew that you [were] obstinate, And your neck [was] an iron sinew, And your brow bronze,

entries.title: Isaiah 48:5
segments: Even from the beginning I have declared [it] to you; Before it came to pass I proclaimed [it] to you, Lest you should say, 'My idol has done them, And my carved image and my molded image Have commanded them.'

entries.title: Isaiah 48:6
segments: "You have heard; See all this. And will you not declare [it]? I have made you hear new things from this time, Even hidden things, and you did not know them.

entries.title: Isaiah 48:7
segments: They are created now and not from the beginning; And before this day you have not heard them, Lest you should say, 'Of course I knew them.'

entries.title: Isaiah 48:8
segments: Surely you did not hear, Surely you did not know; Surely from long ago your ear was not opened. For I knew that you would deal very treacherously, And were called a transgressor from the womb.

entries.title: Isaiah 48:9
segments: ¶"For My name's sake I will defer My anger, And [for] My praise I will restrain it from you, So that I do not cut you off.

entries.title: Isaiah 48:10
segments: Behold, I have refined you, but not as silver; I have tested you in the furnace of affliction.

entries.title: Isaiah 48:11
segments: For My own sake, for My own sake, I will do [it]; For how should [My name] be profaned? And I will not give My glory to another.

entries.title: Isaiah 48:12
segments: "Listen to Me, O Jacob, And Israel, My called: I [am] He, I [am] the First, I [am] also the Last.

entries.title: Isaiah 48:13
segments: Indeed My hand has laid the foundation of the earth, And My right hand has stretched out the heavens; [When] I call to them, They stand up together.

entries.title: Isaiah 48:14
segments: "All of you, assemble yourselves, and hear! Who among them has declared these [things]? The LORD loves him; He shall do His pleasure on Babylon, And His arm [shall be against] the Chaldeans.

entries.title: Isaiah 48:15
segments: I, [even] I, have spoken; Yes, I have called him, I have brought him, and his way will prosper.

entries.title: Isaiah 48:16
segments: ¶"Come near to Me, hear this: I have not spoken in secret from the beginning; From the time that it was, I [was] there. And now the Lord GOD and His Spirit Have sent Me."

entries.title: Isaiah 48:17
segments: Thus says the LORD, your Redeemer, The Holy One of Israel: "I [am] the LORD your God, Who teaches you to profit, Who leads you by the way you should go.

entries.title: Isaiah 48:18
segments: Oh, that you had heeded My commandments! Then your peace would have been like a river, And your righteousness like the waves of the sea.

entries.title: Isaiah 48:19
segments: Your descendants also would have been like the sand, And the offspring of your body like the grains of sand; His name would not have been cut off Nor destroyed from before Me."

entries.title: Isaiah 48:20
segments: Go forth from Babylon! Flee from the Chaldeans! With a voice of singing, Declare, proclaim this, Utter it to the end of the earth; Say, "The LORD has redeemed His servant Jacob!"

entries.title: Isaiah 48:21
segments: And they did not thirst When He led them through the deserts; He caused the waters to flow from the rock for them; He also split the rock, and the waters gushed out.

entries.title: Isaiah 48:22
segments: "[There is] no peace," says the LORD, "for the wicked."
